fundamentals.name: Reddit, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Reddit, Inc. operates a digital community in the United States and internationally. The company's platform enables user to engage in conversations, explore passions, research new hobbies, exchange goods and services, create new communities and experiences, share laughs, and find belonging. It also organizes communities based on specific interests that enable users to engage in conversations by sharing experiences, submitting links, uploading images and videos, and replying to one another. Reddit, Inc. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

judgment.summary: Rapidly growing, highly profitable company with a strong balance sheet and significant analyst upside.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat estimates by 79.1% with EPS of 1.01 vs 0.56; next earnings date is 2026-07-30.
positives: Revenue growth 69.1% YoY and earnings growth 675.0% YoY indicate strong top and bottom-line expansion.
Gross margin 91.4% and profit margin 28.6% demonstrate exceptional profitability.
Forward P/E of 19.10 is attractive relative to trailing P/E of 48.33 and strong growth.
Total cash of $2.77B and minimal debt provide substantial financial flexibility.
Analyst consensus is 'buy' with a mean target of $224.92, suggesting significant upside potential.
negatives: Price/Sales (TTM) of 13.13 is high, indicating a premium valuation on current sales.
Beta of 1.91 suggests higher volatility compared to the broader market.
The stock has already experienced a 58.6% one-year surge, raising questions about sustainability.

news.paragraph: Reddit has seen a significant surge, up 16.9% after reporting strong earnings and announcing new AI data partnerships, with analysts noting its appeal as both an AI and a human-centric platform. The company's robust revenue and earnings growth, coupled with high margins and a strong balance sheet, have attracted bullish sentiment, including a positive case made by Claude AI. While the stock has seen a substantial one-year surge, its valuation remains a point of discussion.
